Sub: Handling of Client’s Unpaid Securities by Trading Members 
1. Paragraph 46  of the Master Circular for Stock Brokers dated June 17, 2025  
(“Master Circular”)  specifies provisions with respect to Handling of Client’s 
Securities by Trading Members  (TM)/ Clearing Members (CM). These provisions 
were introduced vide SEBI Circular Nos. CIR/HO/MIRSD/DOP/CIR/P/2019/75 and
